onboarding.welcome_title: Welcome to the Agentic SDLC Platform
onboarding.welcome_body: Get started by creating your first project. Our AI agents will guide you through every phase of the software development lifecycle — from requirements gathering to deployment.
onboarding.step1_body: Describe your software solution in plain language. Our Business Analyst agent will help you refine requirements, identify market positioning, and create a financial model.
onboarding.step2_body: The Software Architect agent designs your system architecture, selects the optimal technology stack, and creates security and data models — all tailored to your project constraints.
onboarding.step3_body: UX researchers and designers create wireframes, accessibility baselines, and content strategies that put your users first.
onboarding.step4_body: Implementation agents write production-ready code, run automated tests, perform security scans, and deploy to your target environment — sprint by sprint.
dashboard.empty_state: No projects yet. Create your first project to get started.
